units.source_text: 年轻人一旦被找去当名人的将棋对手，就动摇起来了。

en.t: Once a young man was called in to be the Master's shogi opponent, he would begin to lose his composure.

units.source_text: 以我观察的一二例来说吧，同大竹七段在箱根对弈，让车的一盘，从上午十点进行到傍晚六点。

en.t: To mention one or two cases I observed, in Hakone he played against Otake seventh dan; that rook-handicap game lasted from ten in the morning until six in the evening.

units.source_text: 另外，这次告别赛之后，《东京日日新闻》还举办了大竹七段同吴清源六段的三番棋，

en.t: In addition, after this farewell match, the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun also sponsored a three-game match between Otake seventh dan and Go Seigen sixth dan,

units.source_text: 由名人担任讲解，我撰写第二盘的观战记时，藤泽库之助五段前来观战，被找来同名人下过将棋。

en.t: with the Master serving as commentator; when I was writing the account of the second game, Fujisawa Kuranosuke fifth dan came to watch and was called over to play shogi with the Master.

units.source_text: 从上午一直下到入夜，然后又继续弈战至翌日凌晨三点。

en.t: They played from morning until nightfall, and then continued the contest until three o'clock the next morning.

units.source_text: 第二天早晨，同藤泽五段一照面，名人又马上拿出将棋盘来了。

en.t: The next morning, as soon as he met Fujisawa fifth dan, the Master immediately brought out the shogi board again.
